name: workflow-kit
description: Evidence-first Claude Code workflow: verification standards with claim-class proofs, a single-loop-first model where the main session implements and delegates only context-isolatable work (parallel disjoint builds, large investigations, independent verification), a 7-phase plan/spec/build methodology with adversarial spec review, a pre-commit review gate over everything changed since the last review that also blocks while verification is still running, subagent model roles, a foreground-waiting guard and builder rules (no state-changing git and project deny patterns for subagents, added-line rules for every writer) enforced by hooks, a compaction gate that blocks auto-compaction until the session has written a checkpoint, a context-size notice that reports when a session gets expensive to carry, and the CodeGraph MCP for structural code queries.
